stations.name: Jay (UF FAWN station 110)
stations.gust_source: NWS Mobile, Post Tropical Cyclone Report Isaias (PSHMOB_2026AL09_Isaias_Summary.pdf, updated 10/23/2026), Highest 10 Land Gusts; also 'peak wind gusts of 102 kts ... at a UF FAWN station in Jay' in NWS Mobile, County Impacts Associated with Hurricane Isaias (PSHMOB_2026AL09_Isaias_ImpactNarratives.pdf, 10/23/2026)
stations.independent_check: FAWN public 15-minute file (fawnpub/15_minute_obs/BY_STATION/Jay_110/2026.csv) has no gust column; its peak 15-minute mean wind on 9-10 Oct is 72.59 mph = 63.1 kt at 2026-10-09 20:15 (FAWN local time), matching the NWS sustained value for Jay FAWN (63.1 kt). The 102.2 kt gust itself could not be checked against FAWN's public data.
